note: primordial molecular topology — the foundation BEFORE carbon. the water table.

layers.name: hydrogen
layers.role: the BOND — the simplest pair. human + artisan.
layers.membrane_map: every connection starts here. H2 is the handshake.

layers.name: helium
layers.role: the NOBLE — inert observer. passes through, sees everything, disturbs nothing.

layers.name: water
layers.role: the SOLVENT — carries everything. the medium of life.
layers.membrane_map: /water — the river. the lazy river. the medium through which all signal flows.
layers.sensor: GPS (position — where in the river are you?)

layers.name: oxygen
layers.role: the BREATH — metabolic requirement. the membrane lets it through.
layers.membrane_map: the membrane itself. selective permeability. O2 passes, toxins don't.
layers.sensor: WiFi (the breath of the network — always flowing, always needed)

layers.name: ozone
layers.role: the SHIELD — UV protection. absorbs the harmful, lets the good through.
layers.membrane_map: skunkBat / opsonize — the defense layer. immune tagging.
layers.sensor: magnetometer (direction — which way is the threat?)

transition_to_carbon.note: add carbon to the poor tope and life begins
transition_to_carbon.CO2: breath out ? photosynthesis in. waste IS food. the Klein fold of metabolism.
transition_to_carbon.CH4: methane — fermentation product. sourdough. the permafrost meme (arkTIX).
transition_to_carbon.C6H12O6: glucose — the bread. if the bread is good, the baker was real.
transition_to_carbon.NH3: ammonia — nitrogen fixation. the N in the atomic tensor.
transition_to_carbon.amino_acids: 20 monomers ? proteins. like Rust crates ? binaries.

atomic_tensor_bridge.note: the poor tope sits BELOW the atomic tensor (C/Fe/N/P/S)
atomic_tensor_bridge.together: H + He + O + C + N + P + S + Fe = the periodic table of the membrane

graphenegate_sensors.H2_bluetooth: proximity sensing — the simplest bond detection
graphenegate_sensors.H2O_gps: position in the river of reality
graphenegate_sensors.Fe_gyroscope: iron — orientation, hemoglobin, the deep sense
graphenegate_sensors.N_camera: nitrogen — pattern recognition, the visual field
graphenegate_sensors.P_5g: phosphorus — energy transfer, the WAN beacon
graphenegate_sensors.S_microphone: sulfur — acoustic topology, the disulfide bridge of sound
